source.topic: OpenAI ships GPT-5.6-Cyber (Aug 10 2026) — a cyber-specific version of GPT-5.6 Sol under Daybreak Red. Completes 95.0% of advanced cyber attack tasks in ExploitGym vs 1.5% for Sol with standard safeguards. Real findings: 2 unknown V8 bugs (CVE-2026-15903 fixed), 5+ mobile-OS vulns, 3 critical database vulns, 400+ kernel LPEs. $12.50/$75 per M tokens, access-gated (Daybreak approval, hardware keys from Sept 1).
source.angle: split-brain story: same model family, two answers — 95% vs 1.5% is a policy choice baked into weights. Retention loop: the last number in OpenAI's own report (Cyber is WORSE than Sol at vulnerability report writing) is the one nobody is reporting.
source.research_note: Primary sources read start-to-finish: openai.com announcement 'Expanding Daybreak as the Cyber Defense Window Narrows' (Aug 10), openai.com/daybreak, developers.openai.com model pricing page, NVD CVE-2026-15903. OpenAI announcement + Daybreak pages bot-blocked for capture (blank across 3 attempts, waits up to 25s) — kept in evidence set with on-screen 'live capture blocked — source text verified directly' disclosure per EVOLUTION lesson 'Some official sources are unusable'. Pricing page + NVD captured clean and validated OK.

persona.tone_flavor: precise, fast, no filler; names the catch; analyst voice

honesty_guard: see niches/ai-news.json script.honesty_guard + recency_guard — every number needs a real captured source; the 95.0/1.5/2.0/57.3 table is OpenAI self-reported, attributed to the announcement out loud. Distinguish 'announced' from 'fixed' (CVE-2026-15903) from 'under disclosure' (second V8 bug). Recency: state 'as of the announcement, Aug 10' on screen.
brand_promise_note: phase 1 (cold-open-claim + context + verdict) hard-capped ~170s (~485 words at Andrew's measured rate) regardless of total length — see niches/ai-news.json script.structure. Turnaround angle worked once (close: 'we tracked this one the day it dropped').

intake.note: ai-release-intake audit: OpenAI announcement + Daybreak page + model pricing + NVD CVE-2026-15903 read in full. All numbers re-verified live at write time (recency_guard). Evidence: 2 clean captures (pricing, NVD) + 2 bot-blocked (announcement, Daybreak) wired with on-screen disclosure. Runtime 6 min confirmed by user at intake.
